newsitem.title: UK: Lacklustre LIFFE sugar firms amid low volume.
newsitem.headline: Lacklustre LIFFE sugar firms amid low volume.

text.p: LIFFE sugar firmed in low volume, but the rise in prices was small and demonstrated the market's lack of underlying strength, traders said.
By 1655 GMT May was up 70 cents at $309.00, having seen a high of $310.00. May volume by then was 658 lots of a total 784 lots.
"Technically it looks reasonably steady," one trader said. "But there's no fundamental reason for it to go any higher."

In fundamental news, a revised forecast for carryover non-quota "C" sugar into the 1997/98 marketing season was due to be discussed for the first time by the European Union's (EU) sugar management committee on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
